content: Tsoa non hashoan yohuan hihbo quin hihquibo
Jaatian jahuen haxenicabo sca joxon, Jesus yocacanquin: —¿Papan jihuemati janin tsoa non hashoan yohuan hihbo quin, hihbon?
Baque pishca quenabohanxon sca jato tocanbi nichinquin.
Naponbi nichinxon sca: —Hen mato yohinon, nincanahue. Baque pishca quescanahue. Shinan ponteyamahax tah man Papan jihuemati janin nocotimabirestihi.
Jahuen hapoti coshi yamahi ta nea baque pishcaten honanihqui. Jascajaquin shinanaibo ta Papan jihuemati janin hashoan yohuan hihbo qui.
Nescapa baque pishca huesti res heen janen sirijaquin bihxon yanapanquin tah man hea rihbi jascajahi.
Hohchapan man paquemis hihqui.

Nescapa hea nincacoinai baque pishca hohchamahi joni ta hihti hohcha jaiqui. Hihtihosi macan renti qui tenexxon hian naponbi potahah jenimatihihma bi ta nescapa pishca jan hohchamani copi Papan casticanah hihti tiromati qui.

Mai mehabo ta hahraai hihyaxihquiqui, huetsabo hohchamanish. Hohchati qui caibo tecayacahinti hahtipahyamahibaan bi ta jato hohchamanibo hashoan hahraai hihyaxihquiqui, Papan casticanti jato qui paquetah.

¿Miin mequeman min hohchatain? Mextehue. ¿Miin tahen min hohcatain? Taxtehihxon potahue. Mento hihyamahax chantohax queyoyamanox manatah cahen tiromama. Rabe mequenyahpahax rabe taheyahpa chihi qui potahah cahen hihti tiromahan.
¿Miin beron mia hohchamahiquin? Tsecaxon potahue. Rabe beroyahpahax bi johuehihnatai chihi perehihqui janin cahá ta tiroma bi res qui. Benchehax bi queyoyamanox manatah cahen hashoan siri.
Manotai carnero
Coiramenahue. Nescapa baque pishca jahuajoma hihqui man shinanmis. Naihohxon ta jato coiranquin jascabijaquin heen naihoh queha Papa yocaxoncaniqui jahuen yonotibaan.
Manotaibo jihuemahi tah hen joníqui.
Huesti joni cien carnerobo jai quesca tah qui. Huesti jahuen carnero cahen manotan. Noventinueve pasto janinbi potabahini ta manotai huesti benahi sca catihiqui.
Caxon merahax ta jahan hihti jenimatihiqui. Texe behnotaxma pasto chian nichi copi jenimahax bi ta manotai rahma merahax hashoan jenimascaiqui. Jasca coin tah qui.
Ni huestibi nescapa baque pishca manotima ta maton naihoh queha Papa queenihqui.
Jascabi sca janon jenehue, non jatihi
Miin huetsa mihqui hohchataiya jaa benahi caxon, jaa huesti yohuanquihnxon jan hohchatai yohihue. Mian yohihah jaan nincacaiya tah min miin huetsa merarihbi sca jai, jan manoquehana.

Min yohihah bi nincacatsihyamahiya huetsa rihbi miin huetsa benatahhue. Huesti hihyamahiya rabe meraxon, hioxon, jaton nincanonbi miin huetsa yohirihbihue. Huishani joi jai quescaquin hahhue, Yohicoin sta jaaxqui jaábo hihxon rabe hioxon man yohuanai nincamaquin.

Jaabaan rihbi yohihah bi nincacatsihyamaparihiya, miin huetsabo jatihibi sca yohihue. Jatihixonbi sca yohihah bi nincayosmaparihiya, nahua tah qui hihxon jenebahinscahue, miin caibohax bi nahuascai quescanon.

Hen mato yohinon nincanahue. Jascabi sca janon man mainxon jascajaquin yohihi jatihibi ta naihohxon jascarihbihi yohihah sca jatihiqui. Man mainxon yohixon bexojahi jatihibi ta naihohxon rihbi bexojaha sca jatihiqui.
Huetsa rihbi hen mato yohinon: Huesti shinanyaxon man joni huetsa betan tsinquixon yocacah ta man yocacai jatihibi heen naihoh queha Papan mato hahxontihiqui.
Jano man rabe hihyamahax quimisha joni heen janen tsinquitai janin tah hen hea rihbi hihtihi. Jaa copi Papan mato hahxontihiqui honannahue —jato jaquin.

Jesus patax nihquirani joxon Pedronen yocaquin: —¿Jahuentihi coti noquen huetsa noque qui tiromahah bi non hahan shinanxon, jascabi sca janon jenehue non jatihin, Hihbon, noque qui jan tiromahi non shinanyamascanon? ¿Hasta siete coti non jascajatihin?
—Siete coti res ma bi setenta coti siete janaxon toponah, jano caman, rahan.
Papan jihue cahen quiquin hapon hahcai quescapah. Jaa quiquin hapon cahqui jaton cuenta copi jahuen jonibo betan bexohah.
Jaton cuenta toponhihnihiya bi jaton hani coriqui huesti mil ribinai joni jahui.

Jahuatohonbi jahuen ribin copijatimahiya sca: Hina sca jaábo nea joni maromanahue, jahuen haiboya jahuen baquebo rihbi maromaxon jahuen jahuaborabo jatihibi maromanahue, jan ribinai copi hen coriqui bihnon hah ca hapon jai.
Jaatian ta raboxonen nihxon jahuen jonin hihti yocatihiqui: Hea tenehue, hihbon. Mia tah hen jatihibi copijayaxihqui.
Hahan shinanxon sca ta Jascabi sca janon jenehue jahuen hapon jatihiqui, ribinjoma sca jan janon.
Ribinjoma caxon sca cahen jahuen hahbe teenica cien coriqui res jaa ribinai meratihi. Meraxon texecobahinxon, Min hea ribinai hea copijatahi tsoh hahtihi.
Raboxonen nihxon sca ta jahuen hahbe teenicaton hihti yocatihiqui: Hea tenehue. Mia tah hen copijayaxihqui.
Jan hihti yocacah bi cahen jeenhahyamaxon bi policia bihmaxon jatihibi jan copijanon caman sipo xoboho tsahontihi.
Jan jascajahi jisish texe jahuen hahbe teenicabo hihti benati. Benatax ta jaton hapo yohihi caxon jatihibi yohicantihiqui.
Jahuen joni quenamaxon sca ta jahuen hapon yohitihiqui: Tiroman, min hea hihti yocacah tah hen mia Jascabi sca janon jenehue hahcaqui.
Hen mia jascajaxonah cahen mian rihbi sca miin hahbe teetai joni mian hahxontihi, hahquin.
Sinaxon sca ta jahuen sipo xobo coirannicabo jaa joni hinantihiqui, jahuen ribin jatihibi copijanon caman.
Maton huetsa mato qui tiromahah bi man maton jointiboyaxonbi man jaa hohmismayamahiya ta heen naihoh queha Papan maton hohcha shinanbehnoyamarihbitihiqui —Jesusen jato jaquin.
